# Feature request

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](feature_request.vi.md)

## Problem

What user problem or limitation are you trying to solve?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest useful behavior change.

## Why it fits this repository

Explain how the request relates to TranslateGemma 12B IT, Kaggle TPU v5e-8, REST serving, text/vision translation, reliability, security, or developer usability.

## Compatibility

Does the request change any of these contracts?

- one TPU worker / 8-device mesh `[1,8]`;
- BF16 or strict checkpoint loading;
- split compilation;
- REST endpoint schema;
- authentication;
- notebook workflow.

## Alternatives

Describe workarounds or simpler alternatives you considered.
